_meta.anthropic/searchHint: cheap destinations where to fly budget travel ideas

description: Where can I fly cheaply from here? Lists the cheapest destinations from an origin for a month, optionally under a budget. Example: {"origin":"ABJ","month":"2026-12","budget":400,"currency":"EUR"}.

budget.description: Max price per person in the display currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 display currency. Default EUR. XOF is shown as FCFA.

month.description: Travel month, YYYY-MM. Default: next 30 days.

origin.description: Departure airport or city: a 3-letter IATA airport/metro code (ABJ, DSS, LOS, CDG, LON, NYC) or a plain name ("Abidjan", "Paris").

name: explore_cheap_destinations
title: Explore cheap destinations
